title: POKEMON PL
notes: Renegade Platinum (Drayano), a ROM hack of Pokemon Platinum (USA) Rev 1.
A Nintendo DS cartridge is a filesystem: every extraction stage opens a file by
its path, and the hack keeps Platinum's paths, so this manifest carries only which
dump is this game -- RomImporter reads romSha1. The file is the trimmed patched
ROM (104,922,516 bytes); its header still says CPUE revision 1.
